==Image==
The banner of Tear is displayed, while it is known what her own banner is. Or, that is what I think when I read this text. But maybe her colours are unknown? [[User:Asha&#39;man Leyrann Gaidin|Asha&#39;man Leyrann Gaidin]] 12:25, June 2, 2011 (UTC)
:The character template displays colors based on nationality, Ajah (if Aes Sedai), rank (if Asha'man), and sometimes occupation (i.e. entertainers and such). As for the image, if we don't have a picture of the character, we use whatever the template's colors are going to be. So, if a character's template has Tairen colors, he or she gets the Tairen flag. If we have a picture of her personal banner, it can go in the main part of the article, like the [[con]] on various [[Cairhienin]]. ----[[User:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#0080FF;"> '''Willie'''</span>]] - [[User Talk:Mainphramephreak|<span style="color:#990099;">'''''HtS'''''</span>]] 15:51, June 2, 2011 (UTC)
